mapper.select: SELECT AS group_key,MAX(publish_date) last_date,MAX(id) last_id FROM godp_planning_item_read GROUP BY ORDER BY last_date DESC,last_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) accounts,COUNT(DISTINCT batch_id) batches,COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(topic_id,'')) topics FROM godp_planning_item_read
SELECT content_type name,COUNT(DISTINCT topic_id) amount FROM godp_planning_item_read AND topic_id<>'' AND content_type<>'' GROUP BY content_type

SELECT account_id,COUNT(*) slot_count,COUNT(DISTINCT cycle_start) cycle_count,MAX(sort_millis) latest_time FROM godp_planning_item_read GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY latest_time DESC,account_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT r.* FROM godp_planning_item_read r JOIN (SELECT account_id,MAX(id) latest FROM godp_planning_item_read WHERE account_id IN #{a} GROUP BY account_id) t ON r.id=t.latest
SELECT DISTINCT week_start FROM godp_planning_batch_read ORDER BY week_start DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM godp_planning_batch_read AND week_start IN #{w} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC

SELECT week_start,COUNT(*) accounts,SUM(has_auto) auto_accounts,SUM(has_manual) manual_accounts,SUM(done) completed_accounts FROM (SELECT b.week_start,i.account_id,MAX(CASE WHEN i.plan_type='auto' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_auto,MAX(CASE WHEN i.plan_type='manual' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_manual,MIN(CASE WHEN i.content_status='generated' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) done FROM godp_planning_item_read i JOIN godp_planning_batch_read b ON b.id=i.batch_id WHERE b.id IN #{b} GROUP BY b.week_start,i.account_id) grouped_accounts GROUP BY week_start
SELECT * FROM godp_planning_task_read ORDER BY created_at DESC,row_key DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT a.* FROM godp_planning_adjustment a JOIN (SELECT item_id,MAX(id) latest FROM godp_planning_adjustment WHERE item_id IN #{i} GROUP BY item_id) x ON a.id=x.latest
SELECT payload FROM godp_planning_task_archive WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload,'$.task_code'))=#{code} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
